title: Factorio

d3d11.selection: DirectX 11 is Factorio's Windows renderer (the graphics backend setting was removed in 2.0.68; --force-opengl is the only other choice)

steam.launch_entry: 1: bin/x64/Factorio.exe (64-bit Windows, default; entry 2 is the 32-bit build; appinfo cache of 2026-09-30)

app_profile.proposal: not applicable: a D3D11 game never loads the D3D12 shell, so HKLM\SOFTWARE\amdgpu-wddm\D3D12\Applications has no effect on it.

app_router.required: Factorio.exe has to reach the application GPU UMD. The release default AppRouter Mode gpu-default (since b19) does that with no Allow entry; the runtime refuses the session otherwise
app_router.rules: Under gpu-default nothing is set before or after a session. Only a lab left in Mode allowlist needs the game in Allow; check first, and put the release default back with the installer's values, not with an old root.

notes: The main menu shows a live simulation in the background (Factorio Friday Facts 362): a rendered scene with no input at all.

A new game: the menu entry New game (FFF-330 shows it under Single player; the label is read by OCR), whose screen lists freeplay first (FFF-330); a save is written only when the player saves or by autosave.
User data: %APPDATA%\Factorio with config\config.ini, the logs factorio-*.log and crash dumps factorio-dump-*.dmp (wiki, Application directory); config.ini is only recorded, never written.
